### 2026-10-09 – October 9: Kicad Frustrations

**3.35h**

October 9: Kicad Frustrations

I finally had enough time this week to start working on my project!

I decided to pick the beginner project Starbie, since it's supposed to be completely guided and easy to follow! ( SPOILER IT WASN'T THAT SIMPLE). I was using the guide on GitHub as my steps

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 212031](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/a785c0c68f571f9175aacc7f7b60ac1b553e764fcdad067d7d7348a308f97dcd.png)

For the first couple of steps, it was going very smooth; I was able to complete the schematic and the labeling pretty well, considering I have done a little bit of KiCad in the past.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/741d25a51077b30e571c2bb7388d9152e8072041539795294e9479c90a0fb37d.png)

But then I got to the actual footprint part, and there I was beginning to get stuck more often, doing minutes of research just for a small step.  I learned alot along the way, but it still was very frustrating.

Finally, I reached the step for creating my PCB outline. Instead of taking the easy route, I decided I should instead make my own design.

WRONG CHOICE

I had no idea what I was doing, which is why all my designs were NOT working in the 3D rendering. I watched a YouTube video that helped a little. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DNTgrTukltw).

FINALLY, after countless attempts, I arrived at a maple leaf. I am quite fond of it, and I am so excited to get routing tomorrow!

![Screenshot 2026-10-09 212516](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/326de2ac797dea6ab2be8ec1031c5b2621430e1d3cb75039a7ca80a7c3262bac.png)

P.S I am going to need a lot of research tomorrow for the next step, since the guide did not cover much of routing.

P.S.S. The reason there are two time-lapses is that in the first one I was filming the wrong screen, and the second time-lapse with pauses was due to me using my other screen for research.

P.S.S I added 30 minutes since that was the time between both of the time-lapses.

### 2026-10-11 – Today I finished my layout for my PCB!

**2.17h**

Today I finished my layout for my PCB!

I watched a youtube video first, to make sure I know a couple tips and tricks before I started routing, once I had some knowledge, I began working on routing the whole board!

I also used the ground fill turorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DNTgrTukltw

Then I added my custom images of Canada all over the PCB to customize to Canada since I am a proud Canadian. ( I promise it's not that cold). It took a while to learn how to do it, google helped me out though!

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 201538](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/762ffe9e8d997639deb6f193c26eb84b537ee83be9d0d296e4c4bd8f278d832a.png)

I'm ready to start working on the Firmware!

![Canadian Flag](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/57d1715ca5c81b64ed0c2508dd72a94517e76626b5926c2a6f35e28958aea184.png)
